description: A short film made in code, the default for a short for a feed (a YouTube Short, an Instagram Reel, a TikTok, a post's video): motion design, type, the business's own pictures and products, music and sound, no generated video. With run false nothing is laid out or spent and the answer is its quote: what it makes (shape, length, who reads it: say that voice, never another), what it costs at the director the owner's plan gives it, with the plan first and the film made from the plan, and the other director's price beside it; say the film's price (tokens), that the plan comes first (planFirst) and the most both together may use (mostInAll). With run true it is laid out now: the plan is written first (the only spend now) and waits on its page in Create, where the owner reads it, changes shots if they like and presses Make. run true only when the owner clearly asked to make it now. available false: films in code cannot run here now; say why, and canvas_film can make the film instead. It needs an act key, and spends the owner's tokens as the chat's same tool would: say the price before you spend.

purpose.description: sell (a product), launch (something new), show (a story or an episode), trend (rides something trending now: find the trend first, among the Trend agent's current trends (agent_open trend) or in this week's news (web_research), and name it in the goal and to the owner), offer (a deal), laugh (a joke)
